data.text/markdown:
Demographic Mismatch vs Achievement

This notebook compares school demographic composition to county context, then tests whether mismatch is associated with achievement.
  • Default year: 2024 (selector available)
  • Geo baseline: county population demographics from 2021
  • Goal: quantify student-area and teacher-area mismatch separately

Metric Scatterplots

  • Achievement-linked plots use selected year: 2024
  • Funding-linked plots use fallback year: 2022 (fact_edunomics latest year)
  • teacher_effectiveness_score excludes Missing Data and No Data

data.text/markdown:
Multiple Linear Regression (LASSO + OLS)

  • Feature selection: LASSO (L1 regularization) with cross-validated alpha tuning
  • Model: LinearRegression on LASSO-selected features
  • Evaluation: 5-fold cross-validation (R², RMSE, MAE)
  • Full summary: statsmodels OLS with coefficient SEs, t-stats, p-values
